question: Estimate the adoption of UPI in international markets via NRIs / Indian expats by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: NRIs/Indians abroad using UPI for cross-border or India-side transactions via international UPI rollout (Singapore, UAE, France, UK, etc.)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian diaspora → smartphone-enabled → countries where UPI is live → adoption ramp.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: In countries where UPI is live for cross-border (Singapore, UAE, France, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Mauritius, Nepal, Thailand): ~14M NRIs in these countries.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers to 2028: Saudi Arabia, US, UK rollouts; integration with Apple Pay/Google Wallet abroad; remittance use case.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: By 2028: 20-25% of NRIs in UPI-enabled countries adopting = ~3-4M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, currently using UPI for international transactions

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 20-25% of NRIs in UPI-enabled countries adopting = ~3-4M.

calculationFlow: Of these, currently using UPI for international transactions: ~5-7% = ~700K-1M (early days, 2026).
By 2028: 20-25% of NRIs in UPI-enabled countries adopting = ~3-4M.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: By 2028: 20-25% of NRIs in UPI-enabled countries adopting = ~3-4M.
